## Checklist / 检查项

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting or refactoring.
- [ ] Behavioral changes include tests where feasible.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or configuration changes.
- [ ] No secrets, local environment files, databases, reports, logs, or device evidence are committed.
